description: Leading with grace keeps me sane #selflove #selfpreservation #trusttheprocess
transcript: I have very different rules for myself compared to the rules that I have for the external world. The expectations that I have for myself don't always align with what I want from the external world. I understand that I have to give the external world grace. I have to give the external world flexibility because I can't change it. The only thing that I can control is myself. And that's not allowing myself to have poor experiences just because I can't control the external world. That is maneuvering accordingly. That is knowing how to show up. That is knowing how much of me to give to the external world. It is not my job to control what people, places or things do. It is my job to control the way that I react, the way that I respond.
